title: 5.2.3 Car on a Ramp — Challenge
description: Build a two-wheeled car using WheelJoints and drive it up a ramp with arrow keys.

steps.title: Ground + ramp
steps.instructions: Static sprites: a flat ground and a tilted ramp (set its .rotation in radians).
hints: ramp.rotation = -Math.PI / 8 tilts it up to the right.

steps.title: Chassis + wheels
steps.instructions: Chassis: one dynamic rectangle. Two wheels: dynamic sprites with a `diameter` (makes them circles).
hints: Place the wheels slightly below the chassis corners.

steps.title: Join the wheels with WheelJoint
steps.instructions: new WheelJoint(chassis, leftWheel) and again for the right wheel.
hints: WheelJoints let the wheel rotate freely and also suspend vertically.

steps.title: Drive
steps.instructions: In update(), use kb.pressing('right') / 'left' to apply torque — set `wheel.angularVelocity = 10` to drive, negative to reverse.
hints: Apply torque to both wheels for all-wheel drive.

requirements.title: Keyboard drives wheels
requirements.description: kb.pressing is used to control motion
